facts.text: All undergraduate applicants to the Aaron Copland School of Music must submit a supplemental audition application via Acceptd and perform a live audition and music theory examination.

sources.title: Undergraduate Admissions | Aaron Copland School of Music
sources.quote: Each of our undergraduate programs requires an audition that supplements the Queens College application process; please ensure that you complete both the college application AND the audition request using the links below.
